additional_info.subject: RE: ID0390657-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / S3 170003330] dispenser Warning - Selftest has failed CRM:00643001086
additional_info.body:
Hi Shrey,
We visited the site for this device today. Upon arrival, the device was operational, and no issues were observed. We disconnected and reconnected the cables of the dispenser fans and performed a reboot. The device operated normally afterward.
Next, we tested the fans via the PLC, and no issues were detected in their operation. We rebooted the device 4–5 times, and no problems occurred.
The issue might have been resolved during the initial cable disconnection and reconnection process. We will monitor the device for a week to ensure stability.
